cohort: 325 pregnant women attending their first ultrasound examination before gestational week 14
finding: While HRQoL decreased during pregnancy for all women, the decrease was significantly greater in the obese group.
mod_finding: HRQoL recovered to baseline levels within 3 months postpartum in all BMI groups, irrespective of the mode of delivery.
gest_age: Baseline: Before gestational week 14, Follow-up: 30 weeks of gestation, 6 weeks, 3 and 12 months postpartum
